# Awesome DESIGN.md

Vendor copy of [VoltAgent/awesome-design-md](https://github.com/voltagent/awesome-design-md). Each brand is a `DESIGN.md` (Google Stitch-style) with tokens, type, layout, and anti-patterns.

## When to use

- User says "make it look like X" and X is in the catalog below
- Screenshot clone work needs a written token/language companion
- Pair with `stitch-skill` when exporting a DESIGN.md, or with `image-to-code-skill` / `taste-skill` when implementing

## How to apply

1. Pick the closest brand folder under `design-md/<brand>/DESIGN.md` (this skill directory).
2. Read that file before writing CSS or HTML.
3. Follow its tokens (colors, type, radius, density) rather than inventing a parallel palette.
4. If no brand is a match, do not force one. Use `taste-skill` or `frontend-design` instead.
